Standard API pricing. Cache reads are 0.05x input on Claude Opus 5.5. Cache writes are priced per TTL: events with an explicit 1-hour split use cache_write_1h, the remainder uses cache_write_5m; events without a split assume 5-minute writes. Fast mode uses the claude-opus-5-5-fast rule.

User supplied cache miss input 0.60, cache hit input 0.10, output 3.00 USD per 1M tokens; context window 262144 tokens.
User supplied CNY prices divided by 6.8: input 9.6 CNY, cache hit 1.92 CNY, output 48 CNY per 1M tokens.
User supplied CNY prices divided by 6.8: input 6 CNY, cache hit 1.2 CNY, output 30 CNY per 1M tokens (Volcano Ark standard online-inference tier; the separate low-priority tier is not applied).
User supplied input 3.00, cached input 0.50, output 15.00 USD per 1M tokens.

Platform launch-promo price: CNY 2 input / 0.04 cache hit / 8 output per 1M tokens with the platform's own USD quote 0.30/0.006/1.20. 1M context is a single flat tier (no long-context uplift); no cache-write price is published, so cache writes fall back to the input rate.
The source lists cache-write storage as temporarily free; explicit zero is intentional. glm-5.2-x is not separately listed on the pricing page and is priced at glm-5.2 rates as an alias assumption.

User supplied original list prices: input 1.40, cache read 0.26, output 4.40 USD per 1M tokens. The dash-form 1M-context alias glm-5.3-1m uses the same rates; the official page lists no separate 1M-context price.
User supplied original list prices before the advertised 50% discount; ox-alpha is an alias of glm-5.3-flash.
User directed AgentLedger to apply the provider peak price at all times; the dated GA model ID uses the same price.

User-confirmed derivation from the gateway price table: the origin routing tier is 2x the zj tier (as with origin-deepseek-v4-pro), so input 3 CNY, cache hit 0.1 CNY, output 9 CNY per 1M tokens, divided by 6.8.
User-provided gateway peak price: input 2 CNY, cache hit 0.04 CNY, output 8 CNY per 1M tokens, divided by 6.8.

Official peak rates (cache-miss input 0.30, cache-hit input 0.006, output 1.20); off-peak windows (weekdays 01:00-04:00 and 06:00-10:00 UTC) are exactly half, which the schema cannot express, so peak applies at all times as a conservative upper bound. 1M context is a single flat tier; the provider has no cache-write concept, so cache writes fall back to the input rate. deepseek-v4.1-flash is the previous name of the same model.

Retired model name that the provider now routes to deepseek-flash at flash prices; dated variants (202605, ga-260731) carry the same rates. Peak applies at all times as with deepseek-flash. Open question: ga-260731 events arrive via the workbuddy channel and may map to a Tencent-hosted DeepSeek SKU reportedly priced 0.44/0.014/1.32 peak (unverified; equals the origin- gateway tier 3/0.1/9 CNY / 6.8); confirm the actual provider SKU before switching this rule.
Uses the Tencent Cloud provider row on OpenRouter, not the dynamic discounted headline price.

Tencent Cloud direct listing on OpenRouter (the Tencent Cloud pricing page does not list hy4 yet): 0.834 input / 0.042 cache read / 2.501 output USD per 1M tokens. 1M context is a single flat tier; no cache-write price is published, so cache writes fall back to the input rate.
